status: baseline inventory; feature completion is not implied
source: shopify-expansion-plan.md original capability IDs and delivery waves
current_evidence: Existing and newly added routes/screens are recorded in backend/routes/api.php and frontend/screens.json.
Laravel AI SDK v1.0.0 now mediates FunctionGemma proposals; visible /assistant routes exist in both storefronts and admin.
17 business tools have structured assistant dispatch tests. Latest actual-model fixed benchmark: 10/17; historical 11/17 is not the current result.
Stripe/custom full-payment integration has local unit/API evidence using external provider fakes; merchant sandbox verification is outstanding.
Full Shopify-style parity, admin payment-method CRUD, separate invoice ledger, partial payments, refunds, CMS editor and remaining planned modules are not complete.

actions.acceptance: Admin can preview the active theme and its published revision.
Authorized admin publishes a validated revision; preview changes do not affect live storefront.
Admin creates, edits, previews, publishes and archives a page or post with revision history.
Published menus resolve only to permitted shop-local destinations.
Guest filters and paginates a shop catalog; page metadata and empty results are returned.
Admin creates, views, edits and soft-deletes a product; stale edits conflict.

capabilities.name: Product variants and media

actions.acceptance: Admin defines option combinations with unique SKU and price/stock per sellable variant.
Customer selection resolves to one available variant and checkout uses that variant's server price.
Admin uploads an owned, MIME-validated image and sees it attached after persistence.
Replacement failure keeps the prior media; orphan staging files expire safely.

dependencies: central FileUploader exists but product upload route is absent

capabilities.name: Collections and discovery

actions.acceptance: Admin orders products into a manual or rule-based collection.
Storefront displays only published collection members, paginated and shop-scoped.
Search returns paginated matches with supported indexed filters and stable ordering.
PostgreSQL full-text query uses matching GIN index semantics; unsupported filters are rejected.

dependencies: current simple search/category route exists; broader indexed search and facets require review

actions.acceptance: Validated import preview reports row errors before an idempotent, authorized commit.
Export contains only authorized shop fields and records job status for large files.
Admin defines a typed, namespaced field with validation and visibility policy.
Product values validate against the definition and cannot cross shop boundaries.

capabilities.name: Inventory management

actions.acceptance: Admin records a versioned stock adjustment with actor and reason; stock cannot become negative.
Available stock equals the result of authorized receipts, adjustments, reservations and fulfillment.

dependencies: Existing product stock field and admin edit are available; multi-location inventory and dedicated adjustment ledger remain planned.

capabilities.name: Purchasing and inventory transfers

actions.acceptance: Admin creates and receives a supplier purchase order; receiving updates stock once.
Transfer reserves and receives stock once between configured locations.

dependencies: Multi-location inventory and consistent stock locking

actions.acceptance: Configured low-stock threshold creates one deduplicated alert with current shop and location.

capabilities.name: Cart and checkout

actions.acceptance: Customer reads only their current shop cart and version.
Replace, add, remove or change quantities with bounds; stale versions conflict.
Checkout validates address, cart version and server-calculated integer totals; duplicate key has one effect.

dependencies: Configured payment selection is being expanded; checkout totals and stock remain server-authoritative.

capabilities.name: Delivery options and details

actions.acceptance: Eligible delivery choices and charges are shown from configured rules before confirmation.
Checkout validates and stores the selected delivery address; available delivery services and charge are shown before order submission.

dependencies: Address and fixed shipping charge exist; configurable delivery choices and carrier rates are not evidenced.

capabilities.name: Online payments

actions.acceptance: Configured eligible shop creates hosted Checkout for immutable invoice amount and currency.
Signed duplicate or out-of-order events reconcile once; browser return alone never settles.
Signed provider event is verified, durably ingested and reconciled idempotently.

ui: Storefront orders show payment status/link; provider selection is in checkout
dependencies: Billplz flow exists in local test configuration; real Billplz sandbox verification is pending. Stripe integration is implemented in the current work and requires sandbox verification.

capabilities.name: Alternative, manual and partial payments

actions.acceptance: Admin orders eligible methods per shop; checkout displays only enabled eligible methods.
Scoped integration credential confirms its bound immutable invoice once; revoked/cross-shop/partial attestations reject.
Integration records an explicit amount and reference; cumulative allocations cannot exceed invoice balance and remaining balance stays visible.

dependencies: Custom machine credential and full-invoice attestation flow exists; partial allocations and merchant manual UI need implementation.

actions.acceptance: Dispute event changes payment state and creates an auditable review item without changing fulfillment implicitly.
Risk signals create an auditable review state; automated signals cannot independently claim payment or fulfillment.
Customer sees only own paginated orders.
Admin advances only declared transitions with expected version and an audit event.
Admin saves an uncharged draft with customer, lines and versioned totals.
Issued invoice is immutable, payable through an eligible configured method, and records allocations.

capabilities.name: Returns, refunds and exchanges

actions.acceptance: Eligible order lines and quantities are checked against prior returns.
Confirmed refund is provider-idempotent, capped by captured balance and reconciled asynchronously.
Exchange links returned and replacement lines with stock and payment differences explicit.

dependencies: payment allocations and provider refund APIs

capabilities.name: Shipping configuration

actions.acceptance: Quote uses destination, package and carrier service eligibility.
Purchased label is attached once and can be voided under provider rules.
Carrier events update tracking with deduplication and expose customer-safe status.
Admin configures eligible service, zones, package rules and rates; checkout uses only current shop configuration.

dependencies: Carrier account, supported region/services, credentials and sandbox
No shipping rates/labels/tracking provider is verified.

capabilities.name: Fulfillment

actions.acceptance: Admin advances a paid order through allowed processing/shipped/completed states with expected-version checks.
Admin fulfills eligible quantities and records carrier/tracking reference.
Duplicate or out-of-order carrier events do not regress fulfillment state.

dependencies: Current order-state transitions are locally verified; partial fulfillment and carrier-event sync remain planned.

capabilities.name: Customers

actions.acceptance: Customer can review the current profile; the server returns only the signed-in principal's profile for the selected shop.
Customer requests expose only the signed-in principal data for the current shop.

dependencies: Customer account foundation exists; customer search/segmentation UI is not evidenced.

capabilities.name: Accounts and credit

actions.acceptance: Customer registers or signs in within the selected shop; wrong-shop credentials do not disclose data.
Eligible financing offer shows provider terms without treating a quote as approval.
Provider decision and repayment events reconcile against a customer and order audit trail.

dependencies: Account registration/sign-in/sign-out are locally verified. Credit and lending need an eligible regulated provider, jurisdiction policy and sandbox.

actions.acceptance: Admin defines bounded eligibility, dates, usage limits and stacking rules.
Server validates the code and recomputes totals atomically; stale/expired codes reject safely.

capabilities.name: Gift cards, bundles and digital products

actions.acceptance: Authorized issue creates a unique code whose secret is shown only at issuance.
Bundle price/stock and component effects are calculated from server configuration.
Paid eligible digital line grants an expiring authorized download.

dependencies: Protected digital asset storage and download access

actions.acceptance: Customer can view/cancel a subscription and duplicate billing events do not double-charge.
Preorder availability and expected date are clear; allocation follows configured limits.
Customer sees the trial/return window and any conversion charge; expiry or return events are idempotent.
Order/account message is sent from a durable outbox and provider retries do not duplicate user-visible sends.
Marketing consent and unsubscribe are enforced per channel and jurisdiction.
Eligible referral is attributed once with disclosed attribution window.
Only consent-permitted, minimized conversion events are sent to a configured ad platform.
Admin sets validated page metadata and canonical paths for published content.
Analytics tags honor consent and cannot read private checkout/account data.

capabilities.name: Sales channels

actions.acceptance: Authorized admin connects a channel with scoped revocable credentials.
Catalog/order sync records cursor, deduplicates events and reports conflicts for review.

dependencies: each channel's API access, credentials, approval and sandbox

actions.acceptance: Admin configures allowed country, currency, locale and catalog availability.
Displayed and charged amounts use an explicit market price and currency; no implicit FX conversion.

capabilities.name: Taxes and duties

actions.acceptance: Checkout presents a jurisdiction-appropriate tax quote with source and calculation status.
Cross-border duties are disclosed and reconciled against provider calculation.

dependencies: tax/duty provider or maintained jurisdiction rules

capabilities.name: B2B commerce

actions.acceptance: Company locations have authorized buyers, catalogs and payment terms scoped to that company.
Buyer submits an order under assigned terms; approval and credit checks execute server-side.

dependencies: credit integration if financing is offered

capabilities.name: Point of sale

actions.acceptance: Authorized POS sale uses the same stock/order invariants and is idempotent across retries.
POS return references a valid sale and records refund/stock disposition.

dependencies: POS hardware/provider, payment terminal certification and location inventory

actions.acceptance: Authorized report filters by shop/time and reconciles totals against completed order/payment records.
Large export is bounded, access-controlled and records snapshot time and filters.

capabilities.name: Staff, roles and permissions

actions.acceptance: Shop admin invites staff with a least-privilege role and one-time expiring acceptance.
Effective permissions are shop-scoped and rechecked when queued work executes.

ui: Admin sign-in and shop switch exist; staff management UI is absent
dependencies: current customer/admin role allowlists exist; staff entities, granular roles and invite routes are absent

actions.acceptance: Admin defines a bounded trigger/action workflow with validation and an explicit enabled state.
Repeated event delivery executes an eligible action once and records failure/retry state.

capabilities.name: Sidekick AI assistant

actions.acceptance: Discovery exposes only caller-permitted registered business tools.
Mutation draft gathers required fields, displays preview and confirmation, then uses the same durable operation.

ai: 17 existing commerce tools listed in docs/assistant-access-audit.md
dependencies: Broader held-out model evaluations and routing reliability; current benchmark10/17
Advanced content generation, analytics and automation assistant capabilities remain planned

capabilities.name: APIs and extension contracts

actions.acceptance: Every business operation has versioned request/result schema and generated client without drift.
Extension receives only declared events and scoped capabilities; revoked credentials stop queued execution.

api: Current OpenAPI describes 19 registered operations; expansion actions are not yet registered
dependencies: extension lifecycle, credentials and event contract are planned

actions.acceptance: External storefront consumes versioned public catalog schemas without receiving backend secrets.
Developer configures scoped webhook subscriptions and verifies signed, replay-protected deliveries.
Verified subject receives a bounded export of their shop-associated personal data.
Authorized erasure anonymizes or deletes eligible data while preserving legally required financial records.
Admin records shop-scoped supplier and purchase-order terms.
Receiving a purchase order updates inventory atomically and is safe to replay.
Reconciled sales, fees, refunds and tax entries export with stable accounting identifiers.
Configured ledger integration reconciles provider responses and reports unmatched entries.
